meta.name: verify-product-image
meta.description: QC gate for a generated static ad image — verify the file opens, matches the requested dimensions, shows the correct product/subject (right shape, colour, label, logo), and has no garbled text or severe artifacts. Records pass/fail/needs-human in verification.md. Used as the final check in the static ad remix flow before shipping.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动验证广告图片的尺寸、内容和质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在投放前自动检查广告图片是否合格
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify ad image dimensions, content, and quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically check ad images before shipping

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会检查生成的广告图片：文件能否打开、尺寸是否正确、产品主体是否匹配、颜色和字体是否符合品牌规范、文字和Logo是否清晰无误，并在 verification.md 中记录通过/失败/需人工审核。
howto.when: 在静态广告图片生成流程的最后一步，Claude 自动对生成的图片进行质量检查。

say.text: 请检查这张广告图是否符合品牌规范。
say.note: Claude 会验证颜色、字体、Logo 等。

say.text: 验证这张产品图片的尺寸和主体是否正确。
say.note: Claude 会检查尺寸和产品匹配度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks generated ad images: file opens, dimensions match, correct product/subject, brand-aligned colors and fonts, no garbled text or severe artifacts, and records pass/fail/needs-human in verification.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically as the final QC step in the static ad image generation flow, after the image is created.

say_en.text: Please check if this ad image meets brand guidelines.
say_en.note: Claude will verify colors, fonts, logo, etc.

say_en.text: Verify the dimensions and subject of this product image.
say_en.note: Claude will check size and product match.
